title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up on sacral pressure ulcer.

HPI: Pt is a 71 y/o male presenting for scheduled f/u of pressure ulcer over the sacrum. Pt reports no pain or discomfort at the site. He has been adherent to all recommendations since last visit. 

Medication List:
- Lisinopril 10mg QD
- Atorvastatin 20mg QD
- Amlodipine 5mg QD

Exam:
Gen: Alert and oriented x3, in no acute distress.
Skin: Sacral area inspected. The previous pressure ulcer over the sacrum is completely healed. Skin is intact with no drainage or erythema. No other skin breakdown noted. 
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% on RA.

Assessment:
1. Pressure ulcer over the sacrum: fully healed.

Plan:
1. No further treatment required for the sacral site.
2. Continue current medications as prescribed.
3. F/u PRN if new skin concerns arise.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: A pressure ulcer documented as completely healed is not coded.

distractors.why: No code is assigned for a completely healed pressure ulcer.
